name: react-fullstack-pipeline
description: React Full-Stack Development Pipeline — from brainstorming to backend deployment. 20 skills covering the complete React development lifecycle.
author: React Pipeline Team

subagent_type.name: react-implementer
subagent_type.description: Execute single React implementation task from plan. Creates components, hooks, pages following TDD.

subagent_type.name: react-spec-reviewer
subagent_type.description: Verify React implementation matches spec requirements. Checks component coverage, props interfaces, behavior accuracy.

subagent_type.name: react-code-reviewer
subagent_type.description: Review React code quality: best practices, hook rules, performance, accessibility, file organization.

subagent_type.name: react-trainer
subagent_type.description: Train a GitHub React repo into the knowledge base. Clones, explores, extracts api.md + patterns.md, updates registry.

subagent_type.name: react-deployer
subagent_type.description: Execute deployment tasks: build, configure, deploy, verify. Server setup, CI/CD config, container builds.

subagent_type.name: react-backend-engineer
subagent_type.description: Build backend API endpoints, database schemas, auth flows. Writes server code, tests, API documentation.
